name: omarock: mpd music player
author: Marc Ewing
description: A music player for mpd in the Omarchy bar. The bar shows the song's cover, artist and title; a click opens the panel and a middle click plays or pauses (with nothing queued, a song at random). Its panel has transport, volume, the queue, an accent-insensitive search of artists, albums, songs, genres and playlists, mpd stored playlists you build as you browse, and an info card (i) with everything known about a song, album, station or channel; Expand gives a bigger view, and TUI opens a terminal player. With the omarock bridge on a Mac it can switch to Apple Music (your library and the full catalog), with the omarock-sxm service to SiriusXM's live channels, to internet radio (FM and other stations, from Radio Browser), all heard through mpd, and with omarock-spotify to Spotify (Spotify's Soloist, playing into omarock's PipeWire bus). All state stays in mpd or the services, so mpc, omarock-am, omarock-sp and other clients stay in sync.
